L37: Teaching point: raise the lowest harmonic to remove the fundamental and other low harmonics, or lower the highest harmonic to remove upper harmonics. The spectral region and waveform shape change, but harmonics that remain are separated by the fundamental frequency. A fixed 20 ms time axis makes the shorter period at higher fundamental frequencies clearly visible.
